title: ベルト式小売店レジ台
description: スーパーや小売店の会計レーンに置く、コンベヤ一体型の無銘レジ台。閉じたベルトと端部ドラム、二面のスキャナー外装、店員側を向いた端末と無刻印キー、引出し・足掛け・膝元の空き、荷物をまとめる低い袋詰め面を造形。画面と読取面は不透明・非発光の固定材質で、ベルト移動、読取、会計、引出し操作は未実装。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.962 × 1.504 × 0.918 m、8,296三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An unbranded belt checkout for supermarket and retail payment lanes. It includes a closed conveyor loop and end drums, two-plane scanner exterior, cashier-facing terminal and unmarked keys, drawer, footrest, staff knee clearance, and a lower bagging landing. Display and scan faces are opaque, non-emissive static materials. Belt motion, scanning, payment and drawer operation are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.962 × 1.504 × 0.918 m; 8,296 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
